hotels.title: Central Coast Escape 90 Minutes from Sydney with Championship Golf Course & Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Relax and rejuvenate amid the tranquillity of this sprawling Central Coast haven, boasting an 18-hole golf course ranked among Australia’s top 100. Unwind in the sunshine with a glass of wine in hand as you take in the manicured grounds, enjoy a peaceful stroll around the lake or take on a friendly match of tennis on one of two onsite courts. From sunrise to sunset, spend your days hopping between pristine beaches and soaking in the region’s calm beauty. Refresh with a few laps in the outdoor or indoor pool, luxuriate at Wildfire Day Spa, explore the surrounding national parks, and spot dolphins and whales during the winter months. When it’s time to indulge, treat yourself to alfresco dining at Karinyas Restaurant, served with panoramic views across the resort’s rolling fairways. Surrender to the quiet luxury of this laidback retreat and make it your gateway to the Central Coast’s best.

hotels.title: Central Coast Waterfront Glamour Just 90 Minutes from Sydney with Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Switch off and unwind at this ultra-stylish boutique stay on the laidback waterfront of New South Wales' Central Coast. Escape from Sydney to a coastal haven just 90 minutes away, soaking up the sun at The Beachcomber Hotel & Resort. Set in the charming town of Toukley, on the gorgeous coastline overlooking the glittering waters of Budgewoi Lake, this Hamptons-inspired sanctuary (known by locals as 'The Beachie') is the perfect high-end launchpad for discovering the wonders of the region and an idyllic retreat after days filled with sun-kissed adventures. This lakeside oasis offers state-of-the-art amenities and outstanding service - from the expert chefs preparing signature dishes at Bistro at The Beachie to the iconic waterfront bar, an ideal setting for sipping cocktails. Enjoy your days floating in the blissful outdoor heated pool, discovering the postcard-perfect attractions just out of town, or relaxing by the waterfront at sunset.

hotels.title: Hamptons-Style Central Coast Getaway with Waterfront Bar & Pool
hotels.description: Escape from Sydney to a coastal haven just 90 minutes away, soaking up sun at The Beachcomber Hotel & Resort. Slip into holiday mode at this bright and vibrant waterfront locale that rivals a Hamptons holiday home. Take in sparkling views of Budgewoi Lake from the Club Cyan bar or one of the many cabanas surrounding the heated deckside pool, and indulge your way all day at The Beachie Pub, Bar & Grill which features a menu of elevated pub classics.
